answer: Beacon sampling with a compute heartbeat blocks bulk fakes; each agent stakes an identity kernel with a 40-credit bond. The beacon samples 5% of kernels; a sampled agent answers a heartbeat in 10 minutes, and the ledger mirrors it, exposing a nebula of clones. A miss slashes the bond and freezes the kernel. 100 fakes cost 4,000 credits; five sampled per epoch, so they die in 20 epochs. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its 120-credit income.
